'''Flatleaf''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] from which [[Tea/Legends|tea]] was made. Although it was considered an expansive beverage, [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] were fond of flatleaf tea, sometimes accompanied with [[tea biscuits]] from [[Cobaltia]].
